question: What causes a person to remain restrained in Kāśī?
premises: Attachment to the stone lord arises.
Such attachment acts as a binding force.
inference: Therefore attachment to the stone lord keeps one restrained in Kāśī.
uncertainties: pāṣāṇeśvara interpreted as a stone form of the lord
plain_english: Because of attachment to the stone lord, he may remain restrained in Kāśī.
